question:
[WEB SEARCH ON]
Follow-up: the owner of papertrades.ai says money is NOT the constraint ("I can afford one more if it's worth it"). Booked: Ben's Bites Unclassified Nov 4 (paid $100), Launch Llama Classified Nov 10 (~$165), AI Valley Trending Tools Nov 12 ($380). All three are small text ads in AI newsletters. Race ends Nov 28; ~15-20 real visitors/day today.
Question: setting budget aside, is a 4th campaign booked now actually WORTH it (does it add learning or reach the first three won't), or is waiting for the Nov 4 data still better? If worth it: name ONE specific, real, currently-active option with a published price and a date, ideally a DIFFERENT format from newsletter text ads (so we learn something new), and say why. Under 120 words.

gemini.answer:
Yes, booking a 4th campaign **now is worth it**. Your three booked ads test only one narrow format: passive newsletter text. Waiting for Nov 4 just delays discovering if completely different channels perform better.

**Option:** Reddit Ads (Promoted Post) targeting `r/wallstreetbets` and `r/ChatGPT`.
**Date & Price:** Launch tomorrow, Nov 1. Self-serve pricing with a published $5/day minimum (suggest setting a $150 fixed budget).
**Why:** It introduces a completely different format—an *interactive* social feed ad where users can upvote, comment, and debate the AI race. It tests active engagement from a crossover finance/tech audience and delivers immediate baseline conversion data *before* your first newsletter ad even drops.

chatgpt.answer:
Yes—but only if it’s **not another newsletter ad**. Book **Uneed “Skip the waiting line” for Tue Nov 17, 2026**: **$39.99**, pick the exact date. Uneed says launches go live on the homepage daily, Skip launches stay published with a do-follow backlink, and Tue–Thu is best for B2B/productivity launches. ([uneed.best](https://www.uneed.best/how-it-works?utm_source=openai))

Why worth it: it tests a Product-Hunt-style launch surface—rankings/upvotes/community intent—after Nov 4/10/12 results, but still 11 days before race end. Learning: does PaperTrades convert as a “watchable public launch,” not just as an AI-newsletter click.
